scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && npm run typecheck
scripts.dist:dml: npm run build && npm run bundle:dml && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.dist:cuda: npm run build && npm run bundle:cuda && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cuda.mjs --publish never
scripts.dist:macos: npm run build && npm run bundle:macos && LUMINA_MAC_ARCH=${npm_config_arch:-$(uname -m | sed 's/x86_64/x64/;s/arm64/arm64/')} electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.macos.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:macos:arm64: npm run build && npm run bundle:macos:arm64 && LUMINA_MAC_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.macos.mjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:macos:x64: npm run build && npm run bundle:macos:x64 && LUMINA_MAC_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.macos.mjs --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:macos:all: npm run dist:macos:arm64 && npm run dist:macos:x64
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run bundle:dml && npm run bundle:cuda && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never && electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.cuda.mjs --publish never
